decks.name: LeetCode #572 - Subtree of Another Tree
decks.description: Check if one binary tree is a subtree of another binary tree

cards.question: Subtree of Another Tree: Given the roots of two binary trees root and subRoot, return true if there is a subtree of root with the same structure and node values of subRoot and false otherwise. A subtree of a binary tree is a tree that consists of a node in the tree and all of this node's descendants. The tree could also be considered as a subtree of itself.

solutions.name: Depth First Search (DFS)
solutions.explanation: Use recursive DFS to check if subRoot matches at current node or exists in left or right subtrees. Helper function sameTree checks if two trees are identical. For each node in root, check if it matches subRoot using sameTree, then recursively check left and right subtrees. Time complexity O(m*n) as we might compare subRoot against each node in root.

solutions.name: Serialization And Pattern Matching
solutions.explanation: Serialize both trees to strings with special markers for null nodes and node boundaries. Use Z-algorithm for efficient pattern matching to find if serialized subRoot appears in serialized root. Concatenate strings with separator and compute Z-array to find matches. O(m+n) time complexity, much faster than DFS for large trees with many repeated subtrees.
